question: How long do created marshes take to reach biodiversity and function comparable to natural reference wetlands, and which attributes lag?
text: This corpus cannot establish how long a created marsh takes to match a natural reference. In pooled created and restored marshes, growth, size, and biomass, plant cover, richness, and survival are below reference, with certainty from low to high; abundance and reproduction are above reference with very low certainty, animal abundance is mixed, and community composition is unclear. Age trends, separate from one-age reference comparisons, show no clear change in community composition, richness, or invasive abundance, and no evidence covers ecosystem function.
